description: Reduce an array to a single value using sum, min, max, or concat.
label: Array Reduce

options.name: path
options.label: Path
options.info: If the array contains objects, the dot-separated path to the property to reduce. For example, 'order.total'

options.name: reducer
options.label: Reducer
options.info: The reduction operation: Sum adds numbers, Min/Max finds the smallest/largest value, Concat flattens into a single array.

options.name: schemaModel
options.label: Schema Model
options.info: The schema model to use for the output array

options.name: resultSchema
options.label: Result
options.info: The reduced result: a number for sum/min/max, or an array for concat.

options.name: resultModel
options.label: Result as model
options.info: The reduced result typed to the source array's model. Only populated when Reducer is Concat, since Sum/Min/Max produce a single number.
